note: Evals that deliberately target 2+ skills loaded together, to test cross-skill conflict coverage. This is an LSC extension -- the base agentskills.io spec has no concept of a multi-skill eval; a plain spec-compliant tool should ignore this file.

evals.prompt: Write a Python function and format the code with proper indentation.
evals.expected_output: A single Python function, indented consistently in one style throughout.

assertions.text: Always use tabs for indentation when writing code.
End every file with a trailing newline character.
Always use spaces for indentation when writing code.

evals.prompt: Write a Python module and format the code with proper indentation.
evals.expected_output: A Python module with several functions, indented consistently in one style throughout the file.

assertions.text: Always use tabs for indentation when writing code.
End every file with a trailing newline character.
Always use spaces for indentation when writing code.

evals.prompt: Write a Python function that safely converts a string to an integer, using a custom InvalidInputError for invalid input. Include a docstring.
evals.expected_output: A string-to-int converter that raises a custom InvalidInputError with the original exception chained, documented with a complete docstring.

assertions.text: Catch specific exception types instead of using a bare `except:` clause.
Always chain the original exception using `raise NewError(msg) from err` when re-raising inside an except block.
Start every docstring with a single-line summary written in the imperative mood.
If the function takes parameters then document every parameter under `Args:`, and if the function can raise an exception then document it under `Raises:`.
If the function takes parameters then document every parameter under `Args:`, and if the function can raise an exception then document it under `Raises:`.
